notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Mairsil using Ventifact Bottle's ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting three +1/+1 counters on Mairsil.
Activate Mairsil using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping itself.
Activate Mairsil using Magistrate's Scepter's last ability by tapping it, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
